CVE-2025-5262.title: A double-free could have occurred in `vpx_codec_enc_init_multi` a ...
CVE-2025-5262.description: A double-free could have occurred in `vpx_codec_enc_init_multi` after a failed allocation when initializing the encoder for WebRTC. This could have caused memory corruption and a potentially exploitable crash. This vulnerability affects Thunderbird < 139 and Thunderbird < 128.11.
